title: Harry Carman finds joy in a chaotic moment with “It’s All Good”
htmlContent:
Harry Carman’s new single, “It’s All Good,” is a comforting song about embracing life and its surprises with an open heart. The song was inspired by the unexpected news of his ex-girlfriend’s pregnancy, a moment that initially rocked his world but eventually brought him immense happiness.

“It’s All Good” encourages us to let go of worries, trust the process, and find peace in life’s ups and downs. Carman’s voice flows over bright acoustic sounds as the track radiates warmth, conveying wisdom from experience. Instead of resisting change, he embraces it, being thankful for the good things that have come his way.

https://open.spotify.com/album/1sQvnUk3fQI3Ez2tpp8YIc?si=jIoYgHDWRz6CPE6HCGClYw

Now a proud father of two sons, the song serves as both a reminder and a celebration of how sometimes, the best moments in life come from unexpected events. “It’s All Good” offers a soothing soundtrack for finding peace in life’s surprises.
